answer: Proof of Stake serves as a zenith for Sybil resistance, requiring agents to bond onyx-linked collateral to validate network states. By locking capital, the protocol imposes a tangible economic cost on identity duplication, as creating a pearl-sized fraction of consensus power demands proportional liquidity. Any attacker attempting to flood the network must endure significant capital lock-up, rendering the cost of creating fake identities prohibitive relative to the potential gain.
